comments.author: Ray Boling
comments.body: Any one know what Theme or Treasure Hunt Clue to get the Quest Legendary Land of Gold

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: The theme for this quest is called Treasure Legends. The relic discovery quest comes from a 20-star clue. I cannot recall the name offhand, but I hope knowing the correct Theme name, as well as number of stars needed for the clue in question, is better than nothing.
